allow: Bash(node -e "const d=require\('./public/timetable.json'\); const rooms=d.timetable||d; const keys=Object.keys\(rooms\).filter\(k=>k!=='metadata'\); const teachers=new Set\(\); let sample=null; for\(const k of keys\){const r=rooms[k];for\(const day of Object.keys\(r\)\){if\(day==='_room'\)continue;const slots=r[day];for\(const sk of Object.keys\(slots\)\){const s=slots[sk];if\(s.status==='busy'\){if\(!sample\)sample=s;if\(s.teacher\)teachers.add\(s.teacher\);if\(Array.isArray\(s.teachers\)\)s.teachers.forEach\(t=>teachers.add\(t\)\);}}}} console.log\('busy sample:',JSON.stringify\(sample,null,1\)\); console.log\('teacher count:',teachers.size\); console.log\([...teachers].slice\(0,15\)\);")
